verdict.rationale: Latham ships software surfaces, including the LathamDrive web tools, a document generator and Book of Jargon iOS/Android apps, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has nothing on telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls for any of those surfaces. The Privacy & Cyber practice page describes legal services for clients, not the product's own data collection, so it is not credited.
